label: copy-phase input e when a 3 comes next (copying the bigram e-3)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never during the original tokens or at <DEL>), and only from recall_idx >= 3 onward. 93% of activation mass is on steps whose fed-back input is e. The strongest activations (top examples are about 0.8-1.0 of max) are on an input e whose output at that step is 3, i.e. the model is reproducing an original e-3 bigram. The narrow predicate e-input & out=3 & recall_idx>=3 has 96% dev precision but covers only 67% of the mass. Widening it to allow the 3 one step later (next_out = 3) gives 78% mass recall at 75% precision. Weaker activations: copy-phase e inputs followed by other tokens (sparse, low magnitude, firing on only about 7% of such steps), plus a small tail (about 7% of mass) on an input 3 right after e or 3. It does not fire on e in the original phase, on early recall positions (0-2), or on letters other than e.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: phase=2 & in_tok=e (+8.38), phase=2 & in_tok=3 (+4.80), in_tok=e (+4.18), next_out=3 (+3.59), phase=2 & out_tok=3 (+3.57), out_tok=3 (+3.30). Lower it: recall_idx=1 (-3.04), prev_tok=<DEL> (-3.04), to_go=6 (-2.91), out_tok=a (-2.76).
